## Purpose
The shadcn/ui configuration that generated `src/components/ui`.

## Settings that matter
- `style: "new-york"`, `rsc: false`, `tsx: true`;
- Tailwind: css `src/styles.css`, baseColor `slate`, cssVariables, no prefix;
- `iconLibrary: "lucide"`, `rtl: false`;
- **aliases:** components `@/components`, utils `@/lib/utils`, ui `@/components/ui`, lib `@/lib`, hooks `@/hooks`.

## Read by
The shadcn CLI, when adding components.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
The base colour is slate, but `styles.css` redefines every token, so slate is not what you see.

## How to rebuild this file
Copy the JSON.
